convention: F_W(r) = #{n in W : n + 2r in table, L(n + 2r) = L(n)} / #{n in W : n + 2r in table}; for negative n the partner n + 2r is closer to zero and may lie outside W. Baseline = sum of p_i^2 over fate shares within W. Excess = F_W(r) - baseline.

blockF1.note: With pairs restricted to the block (the fate-partition convention) every block reproduces fate-partition.json exactly. Map A uses this study's convention, which adds exactly one pair per block (lowest-|n| element paired into the block below); its F(1) differs by at most 1/pairs.

mapA.definition: rows: dyadic blocks B_k = odd n with 2^k <= |n| < 2^(k+1); columns r = 1..128

mapB.definition: rows: windows of 16,384 consecutive odd n, sliding by 4,096 odd n, starting at |n| = 8,193 (= 2^13 + 1); columns r = 1..64
